title: Tag-dependent encoded word
statement: Let $C_w,c_w$ be natural numbers and $z$ a Boolean word. Write $x(z)=\pi_1(\pi_1(z))$ and $t(z)=\pi_1(\pi_2(z))$, using the total pair projections. For tag $t_c$, return $t(z)$; for $t_n$, return its fixed-width binary successor, or the empty word if increment overflows; for $t_0$ and $t_1$, return respectively a word of $C_w(|x(z)|+1)^{c_w}$ zeros or ones.
hypotheses_covered: The tag is one of the four elements of $TW$
